accepts.because: one closed session as a single write batch, as a collector hands it out

a model package for this hive's model call, pushed by the colony's llm-registry (GH #858): a PARAMS-ONLY body -- an empty `system` slot, no `messages` -- that the llm cell merges into its live params and answers with nothing. It goes from this path straight to `./writer`, the one llm cell of this hive, past every other cell, because a params body is not a request. The llm cell takes package keys from a params-only message only (GH #853), so no request on another lane can change the model it runs on. Draw it only from the registry's `update` lane, restamped `in_model`

emits.because: the finished handover, for the caller to put wherever it keeps one
the generation failed; the caller decides whether that is worth an error lane

a model package pushed through `in_model` that `./writer` refused (GH #863): its error, with the cell's own path in `hop.refused_subscriber` and the model the push named in `hop.refused_model`, leaves here instead of reaching `./prep` as `in_error` -- a refused push is no session's failed summary, and `summary_error` never names it -- a refused push is nobody's request failing. Whoever draws this hive's push road draws one edge from here back to the registry's `in_refused` lane beside it; without one the refusal dead-letters `no_route`, loudly

a failure of `./access`, the broker that hands this template's cells their credentials sealed (GH #801): a refused or failed credential round. Which cell inside produced it is not the caller's business; a parent that drains nothing loses every refusal

edges.condition: has(hop.route) && hop.route == 'ack' && has(hop.operation) && hop.operation == 'vault.deliver' && has(hop.grant_id) && hop.grant_id == 'grant:openrouter@template-summarizer/writer'

description.purpose: Scope marker of the summarizer hive: bundles the prompt-shaping glue and the writer llm behind one entry lane (the collector's close batch) and two exit routes (the system.handover update, or the failure). The session handover step of R-OS-3: a closed generation leaves as one recency-weighted summary, so the next generation does not wake up empty.
description.use_when: One per agent, behind the collector's write route. Instantiate and wire the ports from the parent scope in the same mutation - an island without a crossing edge stays inactive.
description.contract_in: Every message whose `hop.route` starts with `in_`. One lane is in use: in_batch — one closed session as a single write batch, as a collector hands it out. The caller sets the lane with a `set_hop` on its own edge; what the batch looks like inside is this hive's business.
description.contract_out: Everything the glue emits that is not an in_ lane and not the internal `llm` call, leaving through the hive path: `summary` (the finished handover, for the caller to put wherever it keeps one — a system update, a store, both) and `summary_error` (the generation failed; the caller decides whether that is worth an error lane). A caller wires the ones it needs.
description.not_in_scope: No session lifecycle (the keeper closes, the collector batches - this hive only consumes the batch). No memory judgement beyond the summary itself. Where the summary route leads - the agent llm's system.handover, a store, both - is the parent's wiring, not this hive's.
